name: @qf-jarvis/riya-candidate-evidence-live
description: QF Jarvis EVALUATION-ONLY operator leaf (MVP-P2A.2). The one bounded composition that lets an owner produce real candidate evidence for a hosted Riya model: it reuses the existing Groq staging smoke, then composes the EXISTING low-level Groq provider, the EXISTING model gateway and the EXISTING M4 reply adapter behind the already-merged candidate evaluation bridge, runs the 17 mandatory safety cases at their declared execution layer, and only on SAFETY_ELIGIBLE captures the unchanged 72-case P10 corpus into a blinded external human-review bundle. It implements no HTTP, holds no credential beyond one masked interactive read per phase, retries nothing, has a hard ceiling of 83 provider requests and USD 5.00, activates no rollout and writes no production state. No production runtime, service or app imports it.
